The '''Wayward Jungle''' was a jungle region on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]]. It was located between the [[Yunteh Mountains]] and the [[Unnh River]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wayward Jungle was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
